records.def: PROVISIONAL — The behavioral domain concerned with acquiring, evaluating, organizing, and applying understanding.
records.body: PROVISIONAL — In coherent expression, a person seeks reliable information, distinguishes observation from assumption, updates beliefs when evidence changes, and applies learning with appropriate humility. These are proposed operational distinctions, not source-verified ATÜNED claims.

records.def: PROVISIONAL — The behavioral domain concerned with exploration, experimentation, spontaneous creativity, humor, and the intrinsic pleasure of participation.
records.body: PROVISIONAL — Coherent expression permits curiosity and invention while staying aware of context, consent, and consequences. Distortion may appear as compulsive distraction, avoidance of responsibility, mockery that degrades others, or suppressing play until all outcomes are guaranteed. These are proposed operational distinctions, not source-verified ATÜNED claims.

records.story: A group is stuck trying to avoid every mistake. One member proposes a low-stakes experiment, invites play, and keeps the boundaries clear enough that everyone can participate safely.
records.atunedVersion: Play and Creative Delight is coherent when curiosity opens possibility without abandoning context or responsibility. It decoheres when distraction replaces engagement or humor degrades others.
